origin.usage: na.aggregate.default(object, by = 1, ..., FUN = mean, na.rm = FALSE, maxgap = Inf)

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: Series, vector, or matrix. A matrix is aggregated down each column.

arguments.name: by
arguments.text: Group ids, or a function applied to the time index. Extra arguments are passed to that function.

arguments.name: FUN
arguments.text: Aggregate of the non-missing values in a group. Default mean.

origin.details: The default method. by = 1 puts every observation in one group.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.aggregate.default(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
